steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 11.3-second product demo for [your product], square 1:1 at 1080x1080, from the "29-habit-app-ui-reel" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. the app icon spins in and settles, a gloss sweeps across it
2. a tap turns it into a round plus button, then into a tilted 'Create Good Habit' pill
3. the pill opens into a form card; the title and rows type themselves in
4. the card flattens into a tab bar that slides under the cursor: Home, Friends, Progress
5. a seven-day stats card fills its squares, then folds into a widget with a progress ring
6. the widget turns into an orange book card, which pops into a check mark
7. end card with a glowing name

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 29-habit-app-ui-reel my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,4,8,10`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: Every state is one shape: S holds each state's size, corner radius (-1 = fully round) and colour, M holds the morph timings, and each state's contents cross-fade and squash with the shape. The tab bar's slide positions (TABC) and the cursor path (CK) are tuned to the four tab labels; retime them together if the labels change length a lot. The filled squares in the stats card come from FILL (days done per habit).
